title: Send a text to a group of contacts
blurb: Text a whole list at once, now, later, or in batches.

steps.title: Pick your group
steps.body: Open a smart list or use **Advanced Filters** to show just the people you want to text.

steps.title: Select them
steps.body: Tick the box at the top of the list to select everyone shown, or tick people one by one.

steps.title: Choose Send SMS
steps.body: Click the SMS icon in the toolbar that appears.

steps.title: Write the text
steps.body: Name the job, then type your message or pick a snippet. Add the first name with custom values so it feels personal. Include how to opt out.

steps.title: Choose when it goes
steps.body: Send it all at once, schedule it for a set time, or use drip mode to send in batches. Drip mode is kinder for big lists.

steps.title: Send
steps.body: Confirm to send. People marked Do Not Disturb are skipped. Check results under **Bulk Actions**.
